description: This file contains Flask route handlers and view functions for user authentication, registration, email confirmation, password reset, and account management in a web application.

methods.name: before_request
methods.description: Function executed before each request to check user authentication and confirmation status.

methods.name: unconfirmed
methods.description: View rendering the unconfirmed account page or redirecting if user is confirmed.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, validates credentials, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and redirects to main index.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates new user, sends confirmation email.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms user account via token, updates database, and provides feedback.

methods.name: resend_confirmation
methods.description: Resends account confirmation email to current user.

methods.name: change_password
methods.description: Allows logged-in user to change their password after verification.

methods.name: password_reset_request
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by email if user exists.

methods.name: password_reset
methods.description: Resets user password using provided token and new password.

methods.name: change_email_request
methods.description: Requests email change, verifies password, sends confirmation email.

methods.name: change_email
methods.description: Confirms email change via token and updates user record.
